output.title: A retry storm
output.description: Payments has 48 threads: 600 attempts/s at 80 ms, 50% busy with 300 checkouts/s. A five-second slowdown triggers a retry storm. Jitter stays stuck; a 20% retry budget recovers around 38 seconds in this 60-second run.

simulations.title: Three quick retries

action.text: Retries absorb most of a brief blip. Repeating a POST can still run it twice.
Three attempts amplify the load. The 48 Payments threads can handle 600/s when healthy, but retries approach 900/s.
At 8 s, Payments is fast again with about 3,600 requests already queued. Timeouts do not cancel that work.
Over 9,000 requests are queued. The slowdown has gone; the retry storm remains.

expectations.label: Shop goodput â‰¥ 270/s at the end
Checkout attempts per request < 1.5 at the end

simulations.description: Three attempts amplify 300 checkouts/s to about 900 attempts/s. After the slowdown clears at 8 s, the queue keeps growing past 9,000 at 15 s. Goodput stays near zero through 60 s.

simulations.title: Jittered backoff

action.text: Retries absorb most of a brief blip. Repeating a POST can still run it twice.
Jitter spreads the retries. It cannot remove the excess attempts.
At 8 s, Payments is fast again with about 3,500 requests already queued.
About 9,000 requests are queued. Jitter smooths the waves; it does not fix the retry storm.

expectations.label: Shop goodput â‰¥ 270/s at the end
Checkout attempts per request < 1.5 at the end

simulations.description: Full jitter spreads retries but still approaches three attempts per checkout. Payments queues about 9,000 requests at 15 s and stays stuck through 60 s.

simulations.title: A retry budget

action.text: Retries absorb most of a brief blip. Repeating a POST can still run it twice.
The budget limits extra attempts over ten seconds, instead of retrying every timeout twice.
At 8 s, Payments is fast again with about 1,300 queued requests still to finish.
About 3,000 requests remain queued. The budget lets abandoned work drain; Shop recovers around 38 s.

expectations.label: Shop goodput â‰¥ 270/s at the end
Checkout attempts per request < 1.5 at the end

simulations.description: A 20% budget limits extra attempts over ten seconds. Queued work peaks around 4,000; Shop recovers to at least 270/s with fewer than 100 queued around 38 s. All chips pass at 60 s.
